verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI document at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json, and the MoQ docs say relays are managed through the Cloudflare API (/api/resources/moq). Nothing confirms that this spec actually includes the MoQ relay endpoints, and it is a Cloudflare-wide spec rather than one documented for MoQ. Missing for 10: confirmation that the MoQ relay/token endpoints are in the spec, first-party docs pointing to a MoQ-specific downloadable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
Cloudflare MoQ relays are available through the [Cloudflare dashboard ↗︎](https://dash.cloudflare.com/) and the [API](/api/resources/moq).
